frequency_question: How often are bilateral transboundary water treaties successfully renewed prior to expiration rather than lapsing?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral treaties governing shared river basins with explicit expiration dates requiring renegotiation. Excludes domestic water laws, multilateral conventions without fixed expiration schedules, and non-binding declarations of intent.

skeleton: Named historical precedent comparisons analyzed via structural differences rather than flat statistical enumeration due to the unique geopolitical nature of the cases.
